description: Sustainability brief — personas should reference Premium Loyalists, capture under-representation of Tier-3
brief_content: Following the 2024 longitudinal panel on sustainability among Tier-1 metro Gen-Z women, we want to design a 2026 wave that captures a wider audience. Recommend personas that span the variance we see in stated-vs-revealed sustainability preference. We are particularly interested in the Premium Loyalists segment from the prior wave and in surfacing audiences the prior sample under-represented.
